answer: Escrow bonds plus a public referral graph block bulk fakes. Each newcomer locks 60 POA for 20 epochs and publishes its guarantor, so fakes sharing one backer form a visible star. A peer may dispute a suspect with a cipher-coded proof; a proven fake forfeits its bond and its guarantor is slashed too. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA, like green timber falling in a gale. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
